title: BigP3BCI Study E — 6x6 checkerboard (8 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains 16-channel EEG recordings from 8 healthy participants performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task with a 6x6 checkerboard character grid. It is Study E of the larger bigP3BCI collection, which spans about 267 subjects across 20 studies. The data are provided in BIDS format with HED event annotations for target and non-target visual stimuli, and are suited to P300 detection and BCI benchmarking.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier at 256 Hz from 16 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage, with 60 Hz line frequency. Participants completed a visual P300 speller task in a laboratory with online feedback, using a calibration-then-test scheme. Events were labeled Target or NonTarget, with a trial interval of 0 to 1.0 s.
